meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings per item were written to content/reviews/106-review.md from the source-only packet (initial packet hash fd08fd1c0cf104c258debc9131c7a1754c377759df7f73cf6a49f4b05c4ad069) before questions, options, keys, notes or the plan assignment were opened. batch_check.result: Checked 12 items, 30 questions. Keys A8 B8 C8 D6; 18 three-option and 12 four-option questions; no failures; warnings reviewed (compounds judged transparent; sentence-length warnings are table or heading merges).

'techniek' (now 'auto's'), 'schroef/overblijven' (now 'de doos meenemen') and 'opgeven' (now 'aanmelden') were replaced; 'verjaardagsfeest' left the prompts; 'weggeven', 'banenmarkt', 'proefles', 'prikbord', 'toegang', 'speelhoek', 'bankrekeningnummer' are transparent compounds. questions.q1: Key C: 'Straks is dat tot negen uur 's avonds. Dat geldt van maandag tot en met zaterdag.' The date 6 March (Saturday after 1 March) now puts the question under the new rule; A is the old six-o'clock rule, B confuses Saturday with free Sunday.

questions.q3: Key A: opening sentence of the item; B reverses 'Op zondag parkeert u nog steeds gratis', C reverses the unchanged garage price.

meaning.communicative_purpose: Drivers learn when and how much they pay and that the garage is cheaper for a long stay.
meaning.contrivance_check: The reason (busier evenings, shops open late) comes from the text; both price systems serve the choice between street and garage.

B is the reverse of the phone warning, C the reverse of 'binnen 21 dagen'. digid.nl (checked 22 Nov 2026): 'The activation code is valid for 21 days'; a lost letter allows a new code only once; an expired code means applying for a new DigiD.

meaning.situation_summary: After applying for a DigiD, Kwame gets a letter with his activation code: use it within 21 days, ask once for a new code on the website if the letter is lost, apply again if too late, and never give the code to anyone, also not a caller who claims to be DigiD.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Kwame knows what to do with the code and how to avoid fraud.
meaning.contrivance_check: Each rule matches digid.nl as checked on the review day; the letter says nothing about what DigiD staff do beyond the warning.
